description:
Shown in the property report as the '{N}-bed {type} median' card in the
Valuation part of the Market section.

The subject's bedroom band (bed count from listing history) and the
suburb's median listing price for that band (latest snapshot; one
series point today).

**Price: 15¢ per call.**
